/api/v2/bookmakers/.description: Bookmakers we currently receive football prices from, as {slug, name, last_seen_at}: only books with a price in the last 14 days are listed, so every slug here can return rows on /api/v2/odds/. No detail endpoint, no pagination, no filters. The `consensus` entry is a synthetic average across the rest, not a real bookmaker.

/api/v2/odds/.description:
Paginated list of latest odds across bookmakers. Each item is one (event, bookmaker, market, outcome) tuple at its most recent observation. Standard v2 wrapper (count + next + previous + results). Cached 3 min.

When no event_id/league_id/season_id/team_id or updated_after filter is given, results default to the last 48h of observations (the meaningful "latest odds" window). Pass an explicit updated_after to widen it.

Market+outcome compatibility (incoherent combos return 400):
- 1x2            → HOME, DRAW, AWAY
- btts           → yes, no
- over_under_05/15/25/35 → over, under
- double_chance  → 1X, 12, X2
- draw_no_bet    → HOME, AWAY
- total_corners  → over, under (line in `line` field)
- corners_1x2    → HOME, DRAW, AWAY (which team has more corners)
- total_red_cards → over, under (line in `line` field)
- red_card       → yes, no (a red card is shown in the match)
- european_handicap → HOME, DRAW, AWAY (whole line in `line`, no push)
- asian_handicap → HOME, AWAY (line in `line`, settlement in `push`)

For total_corners/total_red_cards/european_handicap/asian_handicap the line varies per quote and is returned in the `line` field (null for all other markets).

Asian handicap lines are home-relative and may be quarter lines: `line=-0.25` means the home team starts a quarter goal down, and the AWAY leg of that same quote is +0.25. The `push` field carries the settlement rule the price alone cannot express — "none" on half lines, "full" on whole lines (stake returned), "half" on quarter lines (stake split, half returned).

For event-scoped side-by-side comparison use `/api/v2/events/{id}/odds/comparison/`.

parameters.name: bookmaker_slug
parameters.description: Slug only (e.g. "pinnacle"). Display names rejected with 400.

parameters.name: updated_after
parameters.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Only odds with observed_at >= this.

/api/v2/events/{id}/odds/comparison/.description:
All bookmakers side-by-side for a single event. Outcome keys are codes (HOME/DRAW/AWAY/over/under/...), not team names — stable parsing even when teams are renamed. Bookmaker keys are slugs. Cached 3 min. Event with no odds returns {markets: {}}; missing event returns 404.

**Requires Football Unlimited.** Every field in this response is per-bookmaker, so without the entitlement there is nothing to degrade to and the endpoint answers 403 (`bookmakers_not_entitled`) rather than a thinner grid that looks like live data. For the free consensus price use /api/v2/odds/.
